description:
This list allows you to exclude trusted and critical users from **User Hard Remediation** commands, such as blocking users or revoking credentials. After these commands are run, an admin is required to restore user access.
Fields supported: id, username, email.
Include all known identifiers across integrations.
Example: "username1, user@compamy.com, userID112, username2"
name: excluded-users-from-hard-remediation
